description: llama.cpp server exposes an OpenAI-compatible API for running GGUF-quantized LLMs efficiently on CPU or GPU. Place a GGUF model file in the mounted /models volume and set the command to point at it (e.g. -m /models/model.gguf --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080).
name: llamacpp-server
title: llama.cpp Server
